verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents a full developer API for managing, updating, embedding and chatting with workspaces. It publishes an OpenAPI 3.0.0 spec with 67 /v1 paths in its official repository and serves interactive Swagger docs on each instance at /api/docs, with API-key auth. The 404s from the docs-site OpenAPI probe only show the spec is not hosted on the docs domain; they do not contradict the repo-published spec. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API, a vendor-hosted API or docs endpoint (the API is per-instance only), and a published API deprecation or backwards-compatibility policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: AnythingLLM supports a full developer API that you can use to manage, update, embed, and even chat with your workspaces
API endpoints that enable programmatic reading, writing, and updating of your AnythingLLM instance. UI supplied by Swagger.io.
You can find the API documentation for available endpoints on your instance at /api/docs
